note: Adapted from Snyder 1932; original in English; published as Capritermes (Neocapritermes) centralis n. sp., type locality Costa Rica: Santa Clara Prov., Hamburg Farm, the type soldier in the U.S.N.M. (Cat. No. 44099), the description based on 4 soldiers; the original describes neither the alate nor the worker.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head pale yellow to pale yellowish brown with a distinct dark longitudinal median line; the back of the head broader, scattered with rather long hairs. Labrum concolorous with the head, slightly trilobed, somewhat narrowed in the middle. Postmentum slender and elongate, hardly narrower in the middle than at the front. Mandibles pitch-black and twisted; left mandible longer than the right. Antennae 15—16-segmented, about as in C. (N.) donginotus Snyder. Pronotum white with a yellowish tinge, the anterior margin darker and distinctly concave, scattered with long hairs; abdominal tergites with long hairs. Measurements (mm): soldier total length 6.75; head including mandibles 3.5—3.6; head without mandibles 2.0; left mandible length 1.6; pronotum length 0.7; hind tibia length 0.8; width of the front of the head 1.1; width of the back of the head 1.2; height of the head at the middle 0.8; pronotum width 0.7.
